title: Nimbus robot sub-task
description: One command the edge issues to a single robot. The command set is fixed by PRD v5.0 Sec. 6 (go_to, wait, stop, photo, beep, report); the edge model splits each lease into these sub-tasks (FR-3). cmd is the only required field; robot names the target robot when the sub-task is not fleet-wide, and params carries its arguments (e.g. destination zone for go_to, seconds for wait).

cmd.description: Fixed robot command set (PRD v5.0 Sec. 6).

robot.description: Identifier of the robot that executes the sub-task.

params.description: Command arguments, owned by the cmd (destination, duration, etc.).
